title: Pan-Seared Caribbean Spiced Tofu
subtitle: with Roast Veggies & Coconut Sweet Chilli Mayo
description: With hints of capsicum and all spice, our Caribbean jerk seasoning is all you need to jazz up tonight’s juicy tofu. Serve it over a sweet roast veggie toss and bring it all together with our coconut sweet chilli mayo for creaminess and extra tropical vibes.

steps.text:
• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced. Cut butternut pumpkin into bite-sized chunks. Cut red onion (see ingredients) into thick wedges. Thinly slice capsicum into strips. Drain sweetcorn.
• Place pumpkin, onion, capsicum and corn on a lined oven tray (if your oven tray is crowded, divide the veggies between two trays). Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast until tender and slightly charred, 20-25 minutes. TIP: Peel the pumpkin, if you prefer!

• While veggies are roasting, zest lemon to get a good pinch, then slice into wedges.
• Cut firm tofu (see ingredients) into 2cm chunks.
In a medium bowl, combine a drizzle of olive oil and mild Caribbean jerk seasoning. Add tofu, tossing to coat.

• In a large frying pan, heat a generous drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
• When the oil is hot, cook tofu, turning occasionally, 4-5 minutes.

Combine coconut sweet chilli mayonnaise, lemon zest and a small squeeze of lemon juice in a small bowl. Set aside. Transfer roast veggies to a large bowl, then add baby spinach leaves. Toss to combine. Season to taste. TIP: Toss the veggies directly on the oven tray to save on washing up!
Slice Caribbean-spiced tofu. Divide roast veggie toss between plates. Top with tofu. Serve with zesty coconut mayo and any remaining lemon wedges. Enjoy!
